headline: Jamaica Economy Contracts 2.7 Percent in Third Quarter Due to Weather Shocks
summary: Jamaica's economy contracted by an estimated 2.7 percent during the third quarter of 2026 compared to the previous year, as lingering effects of Hurricane Melissa and prolonged drought conditions suppressed economic activity.
why: Quarterly GDP contractions reflect vulnerability to climate shocks and influence sovereign credit assessments for Caribbean nations.
